title: Industrial Heat Pumps: Application Potential, Economic Reality, and Early Adopter Case Studies in North America
content: Industrial heat pumps (IHPs) are effective for lower-temperature heat applications, but to date, deployment has been highly segmented. From an economic perspective, the best candidates are facilities with hot-water loads, accessible waste heat, long annual operating hours, and costly baseline fuels like propane or electric resistance. IHPs can help states meet clean energy and decarbonization goals cost-effectively.
